names.title: Company names
names.description: Company, vendor, supplier or manufacturer names to screen, one per line. Duplicates are screened once. Up to 50,000 per run.

minScore.title: Minimum match score
minScore.description: 0.5 to 1.0. 1.0 keeps only exact matches after removing punctuation and legal suffixes (Co., Ltd., Inc., Group). Lower finds more spelling variants and more false positives. 0.88 is a good default.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Lists to screen against. Leave empty for all five.

maxMatchesPerName.title: Matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: How many of the best matches to keep for each name.
